notes: v1.14.591 - FORGE DETAIL PAGER: PREV AND NEXT WALK THE ROW THE HEADER COUNTS. Owner report on staging 2026-09-15; ruling OWNER-RULINGS.md 2026-09-15.  WHAT A TECHNICIAN SEES: in the Forge aisle rack detail panel, PREV and NEXT now move through every rack in the row the header counts. At ROW C1 · POS 5/18, NEXT is enabled and goes to c1:006; NEXT is disabled only at the last rack in the row and PREV only at the first. When the next rack is not one of the five racks on the 3D bench, the bench moves along the row to bring it on. A hand-picked 3D loadout is never overwritten by walking, and the loadout picker still opens on it.  THE DEFECT. The header POS came from the whole row (rowOf, ROWS[row]); PREV and NEXT indexed LOADOUT, the five-rack bench capped by the slice(0, 5) in setLoadout under Contract A6. The default bench is the first five racks of the Master, so c1:005 was the last bench slot and idx >= LOADOUT.length - 1 disabled NEXT. Not a racked-count gate, not a sort mismatch.  THE FIX. walk and updateNav read rowOf, the same list as POS. A neighbour with no bench slot re-windows the bench through the existing setLoadout to a five-rack window of the row containing it. setLoadout gains two options used only by walk: focus, so the walk lands on its target without first opening another rack, and persist false, so paging past the bench never overwrites deploy_forge_loadout_v1, the hand-built layout (Contract 11). openPicker seeds its checkboxes from the saved bench, falling back to the live one only when nothing is saved, so an untouched APPLY after a walk cannot save the walked window either. The boot restore and the picker Apply call setLoadout exactly as before. Still five live racks; no enabled control that does nothing. SUPERSEDES the unrecorded 2026-09-14 label-the-counts ruling.  PROOF. test/e2e/66-forge-pager-row-walk.spec.js on phone-webkit, 5/5: RED on .590 for the reported reason, GREEN with the fix; the two data-safety tests and the one-focus test were each RED against the diff before their fix; a mutation disabling the re-window (NEXT enabled but dead) was caught. Regression, each alone: 09-master-binding 5/5, 08-forge-layout 17 passed 1 skipped. phantom-ship-gate PASS; phantom-rd-reviewer CHANGES-REQUESTED twice, then PASS. Two Playwright click-stability timeouts in spec 66 did not reproduce on an idle machine and overlapped concurrent test runs; recorded as contention, not as fixed.  DEVICE VERIFY OWED: on PHANTOM STAGING with a Master loaded, open the Forge aisle and open rack c1:005 (POS 5/18). NEXT must be lit and take you to c1:006 (POS 6/18), and PREV must bring you back to c1:005.
